column1: # CSV Metadata Template for LOFT³ Tours
# This template shows the required and optional fields for CSV-based tour metadata
# Note: CSV format does not support layers - use JSON format for layer support
# - node_id: Unique identifier for each node
# - label: Display name for the node
# - image: Filename of the panorama image
# - next_node: ID of the next node in sequence (empty for end nodes)
# - rotation_h: Horizontal rotation limit in degrees (0-180
# - rotation_v: Vertical rotation limit in degrees (0-90
# - initial_yaw: Starting horizontal rotation in degrees (default: 0)
# - initial_pitch: Starting vertical rotation in degrees (default: 0)
# - description: Optional description of the space
